The goal is to find the optimal z∗which minimizes this expression

.1) For some functions E, h and g. The goal is to find the optimal z∗which minimizes this expression. There are no general ways to solve such a problem, however, assuming the problem is not too complicated methods such as sequential convex programming may yield sequential convex programming good results.
